name: Single Stroke
summary: A hand-drawn download button made of one ink line, whose arrow lies down and becomes the file
about: Single Stroke draws itself on ruled paper, or in chalk on a board in dark mode. Press it and the arrow folds down flat and pushes an ink line across the button as the file downloads. At the end the line rolls back and turns into a little page with a tick, ink spots fly and the label says Saved. A calm, crafted fit for notes, PDFs, ebooks and portfolio downloads.
how: Watch the outline and arrow draw themselves, then press Download.
The arrow squashes, folds down flat and starts pushing a line of ink to the right.
The ink line grows with the download over a dotted guide while the percent shows above it.
At 100% the line rolls back and becomes a page with a tick and a splash of ink, then the arrow draws itself back in.
